ov: زواج أعز صديق هو فيلم كوميدي تم إنتاجه في الولايات المتحدة وصدر في سنة 1997. من بطولة جوليا روبرتس وديرموت مولروني وكاميرون دياز.
plotEn:
Three weeks before her 28th birthday, New York City food critic Julianne "Jules" Potter receives a call from her lifelong friend Michael O'Neal, a Chicago sportswriter. Years earlier, the two agreed to marry each other if they were both still single at 28. Expecting a proposal, Jules instead learns that Michael is marrying Kimmy Wallace, a college student eight years his junior whose wealthy father owns the Chicago White Sox. The wedding is scheduled for four days later, and Jules is invited.
Realizing she is in love with Michael, Jules resolves to sabotage the wedding and informs her gay confidant and editor, George Downes, of her plan. Arriving in Chicago, she meets Kimmy, who asks her to be the maid of honor. Noticing differences in the couple's interests and aspirations, Jules attempts to break them up, but her effort to humiliate Kimmy at a karaoke bar backfires. She then manipulates Kimmy into asking her father to offer Michael a lucrative job, knowing the proposal will anger him, but this attempt also fails.
Frustrated, Jules asks George for help, prompting him to fly to Chicago. On his advice, she prepares to confess her feelings to Michael but instead claims to be engaged to George, hoping to make Michael jealous. George plays along but embarrasses Jules at lunch with the wedding party through fabricated stories about their relationship, culminating in a rendition of "I Say a Little Prayer" that prompts the entire restaurant to join in.
